reasoning_checks: Atomic matching preserves finite eligible quantity and price priority. IOC residual cancels; FOK partial execution is prohibited. No-fill averages remain undefined. Alternative orders start from the same snapshot/account.

Both atomic snapshot signs require cash - d*gross - fees >=0; sell targets also require owned inventory. A sale whose fee exceeds proceeds is admitted only if initial cash covers the difference. The dated shortfall model separately checks cash at each fill, including an early fee deficit later proceeds would otherwise conceal.

Arrival aggregate spread uses one explicitly frozen midpoint, not changing per-child quotes. Fee exclusion, sign, common denominator and future-mark horizon preserve ES=RS+MC. Neither RS nor MC is automatically a cash-profit or causal-impact estimate.

Dealer Bayes derivation is independently checked by nature/type/direction enumeration. Uninformed demand is exogenous; the one-share quote is updated after arrival. Theta1 is excluded because strict participation disappears; theta0 is an allowed zero-information boundary.

Passive queue scenarios retain dependence between sell volume and future price. Both complete policies are fixed before outcomes and funded at each date. Cancel-only policy retains the missed rising-state paper gain and is labeled a different completion mandate.

Full-target shortfall is derived from identical initial cash/inventory and common final marks. The alternative filled-only delay convention is distinguished, preventing duplicate delay on residual shares. Side symmetry and empty/full-fill boundaries are checked.

The VWAP sample explicitly excludes own fills and is defined over the supplied interval. Favorable filled-only gross cost does not erase original-target shortfall or establish skill; data-selection and causal estimation limits are taught.

Persistent cost derives from the within-block integral kQ²/2 and reconciles all actual state cash. Interim midpoint excludes temporary impact, shock occurs between blocks, and the second block is the committed remainder. No own-price mark is counted as a cash benefit.

J is E[C]+lambda Var(C) with inverse-CU lambda, not a lambda/2 convention or asserted universal expected utility. Strict convexity and derivative signs prove the continuous optimum and projection; floor/ceiling and all integer ties are separately handled.

Capacity grid optimizes every integer quantity anew, includes abstention and exposes all ties. The baseline6/11/14 distinctions and benefit2 transfer8/14/14 are conditional on separate sizing authority; requiredQ12 is never silently resized.

Impact prefunding intentionally covers every allowed schedule in the full grid, so the stated timing constraints remain the two capacities. This is not misrepresented as an optimizer with an additional endogenous cash constraint.

Delayed completion in the shortfall case costs10202.5 but initial cash is10000. The proposed order is infeasible without202.5 added funding; supplying it equally to paper/actual leaves the202.5 wealth shortfall intact.
Empirical discussion separates exact model arithmetic from identification of coefficients and forecast benefits. No real current venue rule, quote, return, capacity or estimated alpha is invented.
